issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה' means 'son of thirty years' (i.e., thirty years old), but the Chinese renders it as '三十歲兒子' (thirty-year-old son), which changes the meaning from age to a literal 'son' of thirty years. Similarly, 'בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה' is rendered as '五十歲兒子' (fifty-year-old son), altering the intended age range into a familial relationship. The correct translation should be '三十歲以上' and '五十歲' without the word '兒子' (son).
